headline: Education Ministry to resolve 30,000 pending court cases
summary: The Education Minister announced a plan to clear the massive backlog of legal disputes involving the ministry.
details: The Ministry of Education is taking steps to resolve a backlog of approximately 30,000 pending court cases. This move aims to reduce the legal burden on the ministry and ensure a more efficient administration of educational policies.
The Education Minister stated that the ministry is prioritizing the settlement of these cases to avoid further delays in administrative decisions.
The resolution process will involve reviewing the current status of each case and coordinating with legal experts to find viable solutions.
This initiative is expected to clear long-standing disputes and provide relief to those awaiting legal outcomes in education-related matters.

headline: Teacher handing over to police after molestation allegation
summary: A crowd gathered as a teacher was handed over to law enforcement following accusations of molesting a female student.
details: A teacher has been handed over to the police by a crowd after being accused of molesting a female student.
The incident occurred at an educational institution, leading to public outcry and the gathering of a large number of people.
Police have taken the teacher into custody to investigate the allegations of harassment.
The school administration and local authorities are looking into the matter to ensure a proper legal process is followed.
